title: Step 2a - Mastering Feature Scaling for Support Vector Regression in Python

cues.en: Instructor: Hello my friends.
cues.zh: 朋友們好。

cues.en: All right, excellent.
cues.zh: 好，太好了。

cues.en: We already did the essentials with data pre-processing by importing the libraries and importing the dataset.
cues.zh: 我們已經完成資料前處理的基本事項，匯入了程式庫與資料集。

cues.en: And now I'd like us to particularly focus on this feature scaling that we're about to do.
cues.zh: 現在希望大家特別專注於接下來要做的特徵縮放。

cues.en: So I've already taught you feature scaling in the data pre-processing part, part one where, indeed, we implemented together
cues.zh: 第一部分資料前處理中，我已經教過特徵縮放，我們當時一起實作了

cues.en: this feature scaling tool at the very end, feature scaling where we learned how to scale with standardization, the training set
cues.zh: 最後面的這個特徵縮放工具，學會如何透過標準化，分別處理訓練集

cues.en: and the test set separately.
cues.zh: 與測試集。

cues.en: Okay, so that's what we did.
cues.zh: 這就是之前做過的。

cues.en: Now we are in a slightly different situation in the sense that indeed we do not have a split of the dataset between a training set and a test set.
cues.zh: 現在的情況稍有不同，因為這裡沒有將資料集切分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And that, I remind, is because we want to leverage the maximum data in order to learn the correlations between the position levels and the salaries.
cues.zh: 再提醒一次，原因是希望利用最多資料，學習職位等級與薪資之間的關係。

cues.en: So the first thing is we will actually apply exceptionally feature scaling on the whole matrix of features X.
cues.zh: 因此第一點是，這次會例外地對整個特徵矩陣 X 套用特徵縮放。

cues.en: Then the second important point and the second difference with what I taught you before, in the same data pre-processing tools implementation, is the fact that in this situation,
cues.zh: 第二個重要之處，也是和先前資料前處理工具實作不同的地方，是當時那個情境下，

cues.en: we only applied feature scaling to the features.
cues.zh: 我們只對特徵套用了特徵縮放。

cues.en: We only applied feature scaling to X_train and X_test which are the features of respectively the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 只對 X_train 與 X_test 套用特徵縮放，它們分別是訓練集與測試集的特徵。

cues.en: And we did not apply feature scaling to the dependent variable vector Y.
cues.zh: 而沒有對依變數向量 y 套用特徵縮放。

cues.en: But why was that?
cues.zh: 為什麼呢？

cues.en: Why didn't we apply here feature scaling to the dependent variable vector Y?
cues.zh: 為什麼當時沒有對依變數向量 y 套用特徵縮放？

cues.en: Well that's because remember, the dataset for our data pre-processing tools implementation, was a dataset where the dependent variable was taking values 0 or 1, right?
cues.zh: 因為還記得嗎？資料前處理工具實作中，資料集的依變數只會取 0 或 1。

cues.en: We can scroll up to have a look again.
cues.zh: 可以往上捲，再看一次。

cues.en: Remember, these were the purchased decisions of this retail company and that's the dependent variable taking the following values, 0 for the customer didn't buy the product,
cues.zh: 記得，這是零售公司顧客的購買決策，依變數的值是：0 代表顧客沒有購買產品，

cues.en: and 1, the customer bought the product.
cues.zh: 1 代表顧客有購買產品。

cues.en: And therefore since it took value 0 or 1, then we did not have to apply feature scaling here because exactly same as the dummy variables here,
cues.zh: 所以因為只有 0 和 1，就不需要在這裡套用特徵縮放，和虛擬變數完全一樣，

cues.en: the values 0 and 1 are already in the same range as the 1, resulting from applying feature scaling onto the features, all right.
cues.zh: 0 和 1 已經和特徵縮放之後的特徵值，位於相近的數值範圍。

cues.en: But now we are in a different situation indeed.
cues.zh: 但現在情況確實不同。

cues.en: This is our new dataset, Position_Salaries where the features are indeed, the levels going from 1 to 10 and the dependent variable taking values
cues.zh: 這是新的 Position_Salaries 資料集，特徵是 1 到 10 的職位等級，而依變數的數值

cues.en: from 45,000 to 1 million.
cues.zh: 從 4 萬 5 千到 100 萬。

cues.en: And so now I have a question for you, and after answering this question, you will know what to do in any feature scaling situation, so according to you, do we have to apply feature scaling
cues.zh: 現在問你一個問題。回答之後，你就會知道各種特徵縮放情境該如何處理。你覺得需要對

cues.en: to this dependent variable, the salary?
cues.zh: 薪資這個依變數套用特徵縮放嗎？

cues.en: And the answer is, well, yes.
cues.zh: 答案是需要。

cues.en: I'm sure you get that right.
cues.zh: 相信你答對了。

cues.en: Indeed, we have to apply feature scaling because same, we don't want this feature, which takes values much lower than the values
cues.zh: 確實要套用特徵縮放，理由同樣是，我們不希望這個數值比依變數小得多的特徵，

cues.en: of the dependent variable to be neglected by the SVR model.
cues.zh: 被 SVR 模型忽略。

cues.en: And that even if there is not an explicit equation, you know, like in multiple linear regression, this is an explicit equation because Y is explicitly resulting
cues.zh: 即使沒有顯式方程式也一樣。例如多元線性迴歸就有顯式方程式，因為 y 明確地由

cues.en: from a linear combination of the features.
cues.zh: 特徵的線性組合計算出來。

cues.en: And for our SVR model, this is not the case.
cues.zh: SVR 模型則不是如此。

cues.en: We have an implicit equation but still through this implicit equation, well, if the salary is way higher than the features and here this is absolutely the case,
cues.zh: 我們使用隱式方程式，但即使透過隱式方程式，如果薪資遠大於特徵值，而這裡確實如此，

cues.en: well, accordingly the feature might be neglected by the model.
cues.zh: 講者表示，特徵仍可能被模型忽略。

cues.en: And actually I of course try to build this SVR model without applying feature scaling.
cues.zh: 我當然也試過，不進行特徵縮放就建立這個 SVR 模型。

cues.en: And you can check that this absolutely doesn't work.
cues.zh: 你可以自行確認，這樣完全得不到理想結果。

cues.en: Indeed, if we don't apply feature scaling for our SVR implementation and training on this dataset, well, you will see that the SVR model will not work at all.
cues.zh: 如果對這份資料實作、訓練 SVR 時不套用特徵縮放，就會發現 SVR 模型表現很差。

cues.en: So we have to apply feature scaling here on both the feature where the values go from 1 to 10 and the dependent variable taking values from 45,000 to 1 million.
cues.zh: 所以這裡必須同時縮放特徵與依變數；特徵值是 1 到 10，依變數則是 4 萬 5 千到 100 萬。

cues.en: All right, and so now you know everything about feature scaling.
cues.zh: 好，現在你已經掌握這裡所有的特徵縮放概念。

cues.en: You know what to do in any situation.
cues.zh: 知道在各種情況下該怎麼做。

cues.en: You know that you don't apply feature scaling to some dummy variables resulting from one-hot encoding.
cues.zh: 知道這裡不對獨熱編碼產生的虛擬變數套用特徵縮放。

cues.en: You know that when a dependent variable takes binary values like 0 and 1, you don't have to apply feature scaling either because the values are already in the right range.
cues.zh: 也知道，依變數是 0 和 1 這種二元值時，不需要套用特徵縮放，因為數值已經在適當範圍。

cues.en: You also know that when the dependent variable takes super high values with respect to the other features, then you have to apply feature scaling to put all the features and the dependent variable
cues.zh: 也知道依變數相對其他特徵的值非常高時，這裡要套用特徵縮放，讓特徵與依變數

cues.en: in the same range, and finally, you also know that whenever you want to split your dataset into the training set and the test set, well, you have to apply feature scaling
cues.zh: 位於相近範圍。最後，你也知道，只要要將資料集分成訓練集與測試集，就必須在

cues.en: after the split.
cues.zh: 切分之後才套用特徵縮放。

cues.en: All right, so now you know everything about feature scaling and by the end of this implementation, you will also know something very important to do with feature scaling.
cues.zh: 好，現在你已經了解這些特徵縮放概念。完成這個實作後，還會學到另一件很重要的事，

cues.en: But you know, on the practical side, which will be the inverse transformation of feature scaling, you know when you scale your features or your dependent variable at some point,
cues.zh: 也就是實務操作上的反向轉換。當你縮放特徵或依變數後，到了某個階段，

cues.en: you know to get the final prediction and to visualize the results, you need to inverse that feature scaling, you know inverse that transformation to go back to the original scale.
cues.zh: 為了取得最後的預測並視覺化結果，必須將特徵縮放反轉，也就是反向轉換，回到原本的尺度。

cues.en: And I will of course teach you how to do it so that we can not only get a very relevant prediction at the end in this step here and also a super nice visualization
cues.zh: 我當然會教你怎麼做，讓我們不只在這一步取得有意義的預測，也能做出很好的視覺化，

cues.en: where indeed we have the x-axis and the y-axis back in their original scale, these scales of the levels going from 1 to 10 and this scale
cues.zh: 讓 X 軸與 Y 軸回到原本尺度：職位等級是 1 到 10，而薪資的尺度

cues.en: of the salaries going from 45,000 to 1 million.
cues.zh: 則是 4 萬 5 千到 100 萬。
